artworks.title: St. Maria Gaudioru; St. Cladius; St. Norbert; St. Robert
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four religious scenes enclosed in oval frames. The four illustrations are presented in a grid layout with two images on the top and two on the bottom. The top left image illustrates a figure kneeling with clasped hands, looking at an ethereal figure surrounded by a radiant aura amidst clouds. The top right depicts a solitary figure standing and holding a cloth or garment near a small table, with interactions between multiple figures in the background. The bottom left scene shows one figure kneeling and reaching out to another figure who stands with an aura. The bottom right scene captures two figures facing each other, one extending a hand or object to the other, with additional figures present in a landscape setting behind them. The style is detailed and linear, with emphasis on contours and shading to convey depth and detail.

artworks.title: St. Medard; St. Calliopa; Sts. Primus and Felician; St. Margaret of Scotland
artworks.description:
This is a drawing featuring four religious scenes depicted in vignettes for specific dates in June. The drawing showcases four distinct illustrations, each enclosed within an oval:

1. The top-left vignette, marked "8 Juni," shows a religious figure standing with a bird above their head. The background includes a church-like structure.

2. The top-right vignette, also marked "8 Juni," portrays a female figure with a halo being confronted by a soldier-like character in an outdoor setting.

3. The bottom-left vignette, marked "9 Juni," depicts two figures interacting; one appears shackled while the other stands nearby. A tied figure hangs in the background from the ceiling.

4. The bottom-right vignette, marked "10 Juni," features a saintly figure with a halo bringing a bowl to two figures resting on a bed within a room.

The drawings showcase events or figures commemorated on specific days in June, with a detailed line drawing style consistent with religious iconography.

artworks.title: Sts. Vitus, Modestus, & Crescentia; Sts. Julitta & Quiricus; St. Avitus, Abbot; St. Elizabeth, Virgin
artworks.description:
This is a drawing of four scenes illustrating different saints accompanied by certain symbols and figures. The four sections portray distinct narratives:

1. The top-left section depicts a figure with a halo and two others with halos, standing on a shore observing a sailing ship. An angel appears to guide them.

2. The top-right section shows two figures holding palm branches near what appears to be a column or a scaffold.

3. The bottom-left section illustrates a man carrying a small animal, approaching a hollow tree.

4. The bottom-right section contains a figure with a halo holding a staff, standing atop an animal near architectural structures in the background.

The scenes are rendered in an oval-shaped format with each scene labeled with the day of June they represent. Each image suggests narratives with symbolic gestures and postures, conveying stories of faith and miracles.

2. The top right scene depicts a figure addressing a crowd on a hillside, possibly giving a sermon or declaration.

3. The bottom left scene shows a mounted figure riding towards another on horseback, accompanied by soldiers and a fortified city in the background.

artworks.title: St. Ladislas; Sts. Potamiana and Marcella; Sts. Peter and Paul, Apostles; St. Martial
artworks.description: The image is divided into four sections, each containing an oval illustration with different full-body figures prominently displayed. The top left section shows a crowned man with shoulder-length hair standing in a frontal position, wearing a robe and holding a flag, with a backdrop of numerous soldiers carrying spears. The top right section depicts a woman tied to a stake, surrounded by flames and a man holding a torch behind her; the background features buildings and what appears to be clouds of smoke. The bottom left section has two bearded men, each adorned with halos and conversing with each other, both wearing long robes and holding scrolls, set against a hilly landscape with distant buildings. The bottom right section presents a robed individual with a halo, facing away from the viewer, and carrying a large crosier, with ruins and rising smoke in the background. Each illustration is detailed with textured lines, highlighting the distinctive attire and attributes of the figures, who are shown in scenes that suggest historical or religious contexts.

artworks.title: St. Simeon Salus; The Visitation; Deposition of the Virgin's Clothes; St. Hiacintus
artworks.description:
This is a drawing of four religious scenes depicted within oval frames on a grid. 

The first scene shows a seated figure with a halo being approached by three smaller figures. 

The second scene features two haloed figures embracing, with another haloed figure and a bystander observing. 

The third scene illustrates a clerical figure with a shroud, accompanied by a procession of similarly dressed individuals. 

The last scene shows a figure with a halo, bound and standing between two guards or executioners holding long sticks or spears.

In the top left oval labeled "4 Julij," there is an interaction between two figures, one wearing a halo and possibly presenting an object. In the top right oval, labeled "5 Julij," a figure stands with a halo hanging from a tree, accompanied by another figure. 

In the bottom left oval, labeled "6 Julij," a scene unfolds under a tree where one figure assists or pulls another. In the bottom right oval, labeled "7 Julij," a figure with a halo holds a large cross and stands near architectural ruins. Each oval is set within a plain, textured background with labeled captions indicating the saint or figure it represents.

artworks.title: St. Bonaventura; St. Justus; St. Henry, Emperor; St. Antiochus
artworks.description: There are four illustrations in oval frames within a grid of empty rectangles. The top left shows Saint Bonaventure kneeling, facing an angel holding a chalice, set against columns and drapery. The top right depicts Saint Justus, a soldier holding a musical instrument with another figure next to him in Roman-style armor under a cloudy sky. The bottom left features Saint Henry, a king with demons nearby holding a church-like building, with a simple structure in the background. The bottom right shows Antiochus reclining with attendants in a landscape setting with clouds. Each frame is labeled with the saint's name and the date, 14th or 15th of July, with "Israel ex" at the bottom of each oval.
